title: नवाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks why all orders, even the foreign tribes, are inclined to fasting, and what is its reason. Bhishma gives the teaching of Angiras on the merits of the various fasts, such as the one who goes through the month of Jyeshtha on one meal a day who gets unmatched lordship, and the fruit of each month and each vow.
summary.kn: ಎಲ್ಲ ವರ್ಣದವರು, ಮ್ಲೇಚ್ಛರೂ ಉಪವಾಸದ ಕಡೆ ಏಕೆ ಒಲಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಅದರ ಕಾರಣವೇನೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅಂಗಿರಸನ ಬೋಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ: ಜ್ಯೇಷ್ಠ ಮಾಸ ಒಂದು ಹೊತ್ತು ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿದವನಿಗೆ ಅತುಲ ಐಶ್ವರ್ಯ, ಪ್ರತಿ ಮಾಸ, ವ್ರತದ ಫಲಗಳು.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि सब वर्णों और म्लेच्छों में भी उपवास की प्रवृत्ति क्यों है और इसका कारण क्या है। भीष्म अंगिरा का उपदेश देते हैं कि जो जेष्ठ मास एक भोजन पर बिताता है उसे अतुल ऐश्वर्य मिलता है, और हर मास तथा व्रत का फल बताते हैं।
summary.te: అన్ని వర్ణాలు, మ్లేచ్ఛులు కూడా ఉపవాసం వైపు ఎందుకు మొగ్గుతారని, దాని కారణమేమిటని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. జ్యేష్ఠ మాసం ఒక పూట భోజనంతో గడిపేవాడు అసమాన ఐశ్వర్యం పొందడం, ప్రతి మాసం, వ్రతం ఫలాలపై అంగిరసుని బోధను భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: எல்லா வருணத்தாரும் மிலேச்சரும் கூட உண்ணாநோன்பில் ஏன் நாட்டம் கொள்கின்றனர், அதன் காரணம் என்ன என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, ஜ்யேஷ்ட மாதம் முழுவதும் ஒரு வேளை உண்பவன் ஒப்பற்ற செல்வம் பெறுவான் எனும் அங்கிரஸின் போதனையையும் ஒவ்வொரு மாதம், நோன்பின் பலனையும் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: എല്ലാ വർണ്ണങ്ങളും, വിദേശ ഗോത്രങ്ങൾപോലും, എന്തുകൊണ്ട് ഉപവാസത്തിൽ താല്പര്യമുള്ളവരാണെന്നും, അതിന്റെ കാരണമെന്തെന്നും യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. വിവിധ ഉപവാസങ്ങളുടെ പുണ്യത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് അംഗിരസിന്റെ ഉപദേശം ഭീഷ്മർ നൽകുന്നു; ജ്യേഷ്ഠമാസം മുഴുവൻ ദിവസത്തിൽ ഒരു നേരം മാത്രം ഭക്ഷിച്ച് കഴിയുന്നവന് അതുല്യമായ ആധിപത്യം ലഭിക്കുമെന്നും, ഓരോ മാസത്തിന്റെയും ഓരോ വ്രതത്തിന്റെയും ഫലവും അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.109; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां म्लेच्छानां च पितामह ।
उपवासे मतिरियं कारणं च न विद्महे ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, among all the classes, and even the foreigners, there is this inclination toward fasting, and we do not know the reason for it.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मक्षत्रेण नियमाश्चर्तव्या इति नः श्रुतम् ।
उपवासे कथं तेषां कृत्यमस्ति पितामह ॥

meaning.en: We have heard that Brahmins and Kshatriyas must keep observances; what, grandfather, is the point of fasting for them?

verses.text:
नियमं चोपवासानां सर्वेषां ब्रूहि पार्थिव ।
अवाप्नोति गतिं कां च उपवासपरायणः ॥

meaning.en: Tell me, O king, the rule of fasts for all; and what destination does one devoted to fasting reach?

verses.text:
उपवासः परं पुण्यमुपवासः परायणम् ।
उपोष्येह नरश्रेष्ठ किं फलं प्रतिपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: Fasting is said to be supreme merit and the highest refuge; best of men, what fruit does one gain by fasting here?

verses.text:
अधर्मान्मुच्यते केन धर्ममाप्नोति वै कथम् ।
स्वर्गं पुण्यं च लभते कथं भरतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: By what means is one freed from unrighteousness, and how does one gain righteousness? How does one win heaven and merit, best of Bharatas?

verses.text:
उपोष्य चापि किं तेन प्रदेयं स्यान्नराधिप ।
धर्मेण च सुखानर्थाँल्लभेद्येन ब्रवीहि तम् ॥

meaning.en: And after fasting, what should be given, O king? Tell me also by what righteous practice one gains happiness and wealth.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवं ब्रुवाणं कौन्तेयं धर्मज्ञं धर्मतत्त्ववित् ।
धर्मपुत्रमिदं वाक्यं भीष्मः शांतनवोऽब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: To Yudhishthira, son of Kunti and of Dharma, who spoke thus, Bhishma son of Shantanu, knower of the essence of dharma, gave this reply.

verses.text:
इदं खलु महाराज श्रुतमासीत्पुरातनम् ।
उपवासविधौ श्रेष्ठा ये गुणा भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Great king, this ancient teaching was once heard, about the excellent merits in the rule of fasting, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
प्राजापत्यं ह्यङ्गिरसं पृष्टवानस्मि भारत ।
यथा मां त्वं तथैवाहं पृष्टवांस्तं तपोधनम् ॥

meaning.en: Descendant of Bharata, I asked the Prajapati Angiras, even as you now ask me; I put this same question to that ascetic.

verses.text:
प्रश्नमेतं मया पृष्टो भगवानग्निसंभवः ।
उपवासविधिं पुण्यमाचष्ट भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Questioned by me thus, the blessed one born of fire declared the meritorious rule of fasting.

verses.text: अङ्गिरा उवाच

meaning.en: Angiras said:

verses.text:
ब्रह्मक्षत्रे त्रिरात्रं तु विहितं कुरुनन्दन ।
द्विस्त्रिरात्रमथैवात्र निर्दिष्टं पुरुषर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Joy of the Kurus, for Brahmins and Kshatriyas a fast of three nights is prescribed, and twice three nights is also laid down for them.

verses.text:
वैश्यशूद्रौ तु यौ मोहादुपवासं प्रकुर्वते ।
त्रिरात्रं द्विस्त्रिरात्रं वा तयोः पुष्टिर्न विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: But a Vaishya or Shudra who fasts out of delusion for three nights or twice three nights gains no benefit from it.

verses.text:
चतुर्थभक्तक्षपणं वैश्यशूद्रे विधीयते ।
त्रिरात्रं न तु धर्मज्ञैर्विहितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः ॥

meaning.en: For Vaishyas and Shudras the skipping of every fourth meal is ordained; a three-night fast was not prescribed for them by the knowers of dharma and of Brahman.

verses.text:
पञ्चम्यां चैव षष्ठ्यां च पौर्णमास्यां च भारत ।
क्षमावान्रूपसंपन्नः श्रुतवांश्चैव जायते ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, one who fasts on the fifth, the sixth and the full-moon day is born patient, handsome and learned.

verses.text:
नानपत्यो भवेत्प्राज्ञो दरिद्रो वा कदाचन ।
यजिष्णुः पञ्चमीं षष्ठीं क्षपेद्यो भोजयेद्द्विजान् ॥

meaning.en: A wise man who wishes to sacrifice, and who fasts on the fifth and sixth days and feeds Brahmins, is never childless or poor.

verses.text:
अष्टमीमथ कौन्तेय शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दशीम् ।
उपोष्य व्याधिरहितो वीर्यवानभिजायते ॥

meaning.en: Son of Kunti, one who fasts on the eighth day and the fourteenth of the bright fortnight is born free of disease and vigorous.

verses.text:
मार्गशीर्षं तु यो मासमेकभक्तेन संक्षिपेत् ।
भोजयेच्च द्विजान्भक्त्या स मुच्येद्व्याधिकिल्बिषैः ॥

meaning.en: One who spends the month of Margashirsha eating only once a day and devoutly feeds Brahmins is freed from illness and sin.

verses.text:
सर्वकल्याणसंपूर्णः सर्वौषधिसमन्वितः ।
कृषिभागी बहुधनो बहुपुत्रश्च जायते ॥

meaning.en: He is born complete in every blessing, possessed of all herbs and medicines, with a share in farming, much wealth and many sons.

verses.text:
पौषमासं तु कौन्तेय भक्तेनैकेन यः क्षपेत् ।
सुभगो दर्शनीयश्च यशोभागी च जायते ॥

meaning.en: Son of Kunti, one who spends the month of Pausha on a single daily meal is born fortunate, good to look at, and sharing in fame.

verses.text:
पितृभक्तो माघमासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षपेत् ।
श्रीमत्कुले ज्ञातिमध्ये स महत्त्वं प्रपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: A devotee of his ancestors who spends Magha on one meal a day gains eminence among his kinsmen in a prosperous family.

verses.text:
भगदैवं तु यो मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षपेत् ।
स्त्रीषु वल्लभतां याति वश्याश्चास्य भवन्ति ताः ॥

meaning.en: One who spends the month of Phalguna, sacred to Bhaga, on one meal a day becomes beloved among women, and they become obedient to him.

verses.text:
चैत्रं तु नियतो मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षपेत् ।
सुवर्णमणिमुक्ताढ्ये कुले महति जायते ॥

meaning.en: One who, with self-control, spends Chaitra on one meal a day is born into a great family rich in gold, gems and pearls.

verses.text:
निस्तरेदेकभक्तेन वैशाखं यो जितेन्द्रियः ।
नरो वा यदि वा नारी ज्ञातीनां श्रेष्ठतां व्रजेत् ॥

meaning.en: A self-controlled man or woman who gets through Vaishakha on one meal a day rises to the first place among kinsmen.

verses.text:
ज्येष्ठामूलं तु यो मासमेकभक्तेन संक्षपेत् ।
ऐश्वर्यमतुलं श्रेष्ठं पुमान्स्त्री वाभिजायते ॥

meaning.en: One who spends the month of Jyeshtha on one meal a day is born, male or female, with unequalled and excellent lordship.

verses.text:
आषाढमेकभक्तेन स्थित्वा मासमतन्द्रितः ।
बहुधान्यो बहुधनो बहुपुत्रश्च जायते ॥

meaning.en: One who stays tirelessly on one meal a day through Ashadha is born with much grain, much wealth and many sons.

verses.text:
श्रावणं नियतो मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षपेत् ।
यत्र तत्राभिषेकेण युज्यते ज्ञातिवर्धनः ॥

meaning.en: A disciplined person who spends Shravana on one meal a day, enhancing his kin, receives consecration wherever he goes.

verses.text:
प्रौष्ठपदं तु यो मासमेकाहारो भवेन्नरः ।
धनाढ्यं स्फीतमचलमैश्वर्यं प्रतिपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: A man who eats only one meal a day in Bhadrapada gains rich, flourishing and steadfast sovereignty.

verses.text:
तथैवाश्वयुजं मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षपेत् ।
प्रजावान्वाहनाढ्यश्च बहुपुत्रश्च जायते ॥

meaning.en: In the same way, one who spends Ashvina on one meal a day is born with children, with many conveyances and many sons.

verses.text:
कार्त्तिकं तु नरो मासं यः कुर्यादेकभोजनम् ।
शूरश्च बहुभार्यश्च कीर्तिमांश्चैव जायते ॥

meaning.en: A man who takes only one meal a day through Kartika is born brave, with many wives, and famous.

verses.text:
इति मासा नरव्याघ्र क्षपतां परिकीर्तिताः ।
तिथीनां नियमा ये तु शृणु तानपि पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: Tiger among men, so the months have been described for those who fast; now hear, O king, the rules for the lunar days.

verses.text:
पक्षे पक्षे गते यस्तु भक्तमश्नाति भारत ।
गवाढ्यो बहुपुत्रश्च दीर्घायुश्च स जायते ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, one who eats a meal only once each fortnight is born rich in cattle, with many sons and a long life.

verses.text:
मासि मासि त्रिरात्राणि कृत्वा वर्षाणि द्वादश ।
गणाधिपत्यं प्राप्नोति निःसपत्नमनाविलम् ॥

meaning.en: One who observes three-night fasts every month for twelve years gains lordship over the hosts, unrivalled and free from stain.

verses.text:
एते तु नियमाः सर्वे कर्तव्याः शरदो दश ।
द्वे चान्ये भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रवृत्तिमनुवर्तता ॥

meaning.en: Best of Bharatas, all these rules should be kept for ten autumns, and two more besides, by one who follows the path of action.

verses.text:
यस्तु प्रातस्तथा सायं भुञ्जानो नान्तरा पिबेत् ।
अहिंसानिरतो नित्यं जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats only in the morning and evening, drinks nothing between, is ever devoted to non-violence and makes offerings to Agni,

verses.text:
षड्भिः स वर्षैर्नृपते सिध्यते नात्र संशयः ।
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥

meaning.en: attains perfection in six years, O king, without doubt; that man gains the fruit of the Agnishtoma sacrifice.

verses.text:
अधिवासे सोऽप्सरसां नृत्यगीतविनादिते ।
तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभं विमानमधिरोहति ॥

meaning.en: In the abode of the Apsaras, resounding with dance and song, he mounts a celestial car gleaming like molten gold.

verses.text:
पूर्णं वर्षसहस्रं तु ब्रह्मलोके महीयते ।
तत्क्षयादिह चागम्य माहात्म्यं प्रतिपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: For a full thousand years he is honoured in the world of Brahma, and when that is exhausted he returns here and attains greatness.

verses.text:
यस्तु संवत्सरं पूर्णमेकाहारो भवेन्नरः ।
अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य स फलं समुपाश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: A man who eats just one meal a day for a full year gains the fruit of the Atiratra sacrifice.

verses.text:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गे च स महीयते ।
तत्क्षयादिह चागम्य माहात्म्यं प्रतिपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: He is honoured in heaven for ten thousand years, and when that is exhausted he returns here and attains greatness.

verses.text:
यस्तु संवत्सरं पूर्णं चतुर्थं भक्तमश्नुते ।
अहिंसानिरतो नित्यं सत्यवाङ्नियतेन्द्रियः ॥

meaning.en: One who for a full year takes food only at every fourth mealtime, ever devoted to non-violence, truthful and with senses controlled,

verses.text:
वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं वै समुपाश्नुते ।
त्रिंशद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गे च स महीयते ॥

meaning.en: gains the fruit of the Vajapeya sacrifice and is honoured in heaven for thirty thousand years.

verses.text:
षष्ठे काले तु कौन्तेय नरः संवत्सरं क्षपेत् ।
अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥

meaning.en: Son of Kunti, a man who passes a year eating only at the sixth mealtime gains the fruit of the Ashvamedha sacrifice.

verses.text:
चक्रवाकप्रयुक्तेन विमानेन स गच्छति ।
चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि वर्षाणां दिवि मोदते ॥

meaning.en: He travels in a celestial car drawn by chakravaka birds and delights in heaven for forty thousand years.

verses.text:
अष्टमेन तु भक्तेन जीवन्संवत्सरं नृप ।
गवामयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥

meaning.en: O king, a man who lives a year eating only at the eighth mealtime gains the fruit of the Gavamayana sacrifice.

verses.text:
हंससारसयुक्तेन विमानेन स गच्छति ।
पञ्चाशतं सहस्राणि वर्षाणां दिवि मोदते ॥

meaning.en: He journeys in a car yoked with swans and cranes and rejoices in heaven for fifty thousand years.

verses.text:
पक्षे पक्षे गते राजन्योऽश्नीयाद्वर्षमेव तु ।
षण्मासानशनं तस्य भगवानङ्गिराब्रवीत् ।
षष्टिं वर्षसहस्राणि दिवमावसते च सः ॥

meaning.en: King, one who eats only once every fortnight for a year, which amounts to a fast of six months, as the blessed Angiras said, dwells in heaven for sixty thousand years.

verses.text:
वीणानां वल्लकीनां च वेणूनां च विशां पते ।
सुघोषैर्मधुरैः शब्दैः सुप्तः स प्रतिबोध्यते ॥

meaning.en: Lord of the people, when he sleeps he is awakened by the sweet, resonant sounds of lutes, vallakis and flutes.

verses.text:
संवत्सरमिहैकं तु मासि मासि पिबेत्पयः ।
फलं विश्वजितस्तात प्राप्नोति स नरो नृप ॥

meaning.en: Dear one, a man who for one year drinks only milk once a month gains the fruit of the Vishvajit sacrifice.

verses.text:
सिंहव्याघ्रप्रयुक्तेन विमानेन स गच्छति ।
सप्ततिं च सहस्राणि वर्षाणां दिवि मोदते ॥

meaning.en: He goes in a car drawn by lions and tigers and delights in heaven for seventy thousand years.

verses.text:
मासादूर्ध्वं नरव्याघ्र नोपवासो विधीयते ।
विधिं त्वनशनस्याहुः पार्थ धर्मविदो जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Tiger among men, a fast beyond one month is not prescribed; yet those who know dharma lay down a rule for the complete fast, Partha.

verses.text:
अनार्तो व्याधिरहितो गच्छेदनशनं तु यः ।
पदे पदे यज्ञफलं स प्राप्नोति न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: One who is neither distressed nor ill and sets out on the complete fast gains the fruit of a sacrifice at every step, without doubt.

verses.text:
दिवं हंसप्रयुक्तेन विमानेन स गच्छति ।
शतं चाप्सरसः कन्या रमयन्त्यपि तं नरम् ॥

meaning.en: He goes to heaven in a car drawn by swans, and a hundred maiden Apsaras delight that man.

verses.text:
आर्तो वा व्याधितो वापि गच्छेदनशनं तु यः ।
शतं वर्षसहस्राणां मोदते दिवि स प्रभो ।
काञ्चीनूपुरशब्देन सुप्तश्चैव प्रबोध्यते ॥

meaning.en: But one who goes on the complete fast while afflicted or ill, my lord, rejoices in heaven for a hundred thousand years, and when he sleeps he is awakened by the jingle of girdles and anklets.

verses.text:
सहस्रहंससंयुक्ते विमाने सोमवर्चसि ।
स गत्वा स्त्रीशताकीर्णे रमते भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Having gone in a moon-bright car yoked to a thousand swans, he delights, bull of the Bharatas, surrounded by hundreds of women.

verses.text:
क्षीणस्याप्यायनं दृष्टं क्षतस्य क्षतरोहणम् ।
व्याधितस्यौषधग्रामः क्रुद्धस्य च प्रसादनम् ॥

meaning.en: Nourishing the weak, healing the wounded, a store of medicines for the sick, and soothing the angry are seen to be good works;

verses.text:
दुःखितस्यार्थमानाभ्यां द्रव्याणां प्रतिपादनम् ।
न चैते स्वर्गकामस्य रोचन्ते सुखमेधसः ॥

meaning.en: so too is giving goods to the sorrowful, with wealth and honour. But these do not appeal to one who desires heaven and seeks only comfort.

verses.text:
अतः स कामसंयुक्तो विमाने हेमसंनिभे ।
रमते स्त्रीशताकीर्णे पुरुषोऽलंकृतः शुभे ॥

meaning.en: So, filled with desires, that adorned man delights in an auspicious golden car, crowded with hundreds of women.

verses.text:
स्वस्थः सफलसंकल्पः सुखी विगतकल्मषः ।
अनश्नन्देहमुत्सृज्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥

meaning.en: Healthy, his resolves fulfilled, happy and free of sin, a man who gives up his body by fasting gains that fruit.

verses.text:
बालसूर्यप्रतीकाशे विमाने हेमवर्चसि ।
वैडूर्यमुक्ताखचिते वीणामुरजनादिते ॥

meaning.en: In a car shining like the young sun, golden-hued, studded with lapis lazuli and pearls, resounding with lutes and drums,

verses.text:
पताकादीपिकाकीर्णे दिव्यघण्टानिनादिते ।
स्त्रीसहस्रानुचरिते स नरः सुखमेधते ॥

meaning.en: strewn with banners and lamps, ringing with divine bells and attended by thousands of women, that man prospers in bliss.

verses.text:
यावन्ति रोमकूपाणि तस्य गात्रेषु पाण्डव ।
तावन्त्येव सहस्राणि वर्षाणां दिवि मोदते ॥

meaning.en: Pandava, for as many thousands of years as there are pores on his body, he rejoices in heaven.

verses.text:
नास्ति वेदात्परं शास्त्रं नास्ति मातृसमो गुरुः ।
न धर्मात्परमो लाभस्तपो नानशनात्परम् ॥

meaning.en: There is no scripture higher than the Veda, no teacher equal to a mother, no gain greater than dharma, and no austerity greater than fasting.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः परं नास्ति पावनं दिवि चेह च ।
उपवासैस्तथा तुल्यं तपःकर्म न विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: In heaven and here there is no purifier higher than Brahmins, and no act of austerity equals fasting.

verses.text:
उपोष्य विधिवद्देवास्त्रिदिवं प्रतिपेदिरे ।
ऋषयश्च परां सिद्धिमुपवासैरवाप्नुवन् ॥

meaning.en: By fasting properly, the gods attained heaven, and the sages gained the highest perfection through fasts.

verses.text:
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं हि विश्वामित्रेण धीमता ।
क्षान्तमेकेन भक्तेन तेन विप्रत्वमागतः ॥

meaning.en: The wise Vishvamitra endured for a divine thousand years on one meal a day, and by that he attained Brahminhood.

verses.text:
च्यवनो जमदग्निश्च वसिष्ठो गौतमो भृगुः ।
सर्व एव दिवं प्राप्ताः क्षमावन्तो महर्षयः ॥

meaning.en: Chyavana, Jamadagni, Vasishtha, Gautama and Bhrigu: all these patient great sages reached heaven.

verses.text:
इदमङ्गिरसा पूर्वं महर्षिभ्यः प्रदर्शितम् ।
यः प्रदर्शयते नित्यं न स दुःखमवाप्नुते ॥

meaning.en: This was shown long ago by Angiras to the great sages; one who always shows it to others never meets sorrow.

verses.text:
इमं तु कौन्तेय यथाक्रमं विधिं
प्रवर्तितं ह्यङ्गिरसा महर्षिणा ।
पठेत यो वै शृणुयाच्च नित्यदा
न विद्यते तस्य नरस्य किल्बिषम् ॥

meaning.en: Son of Kunti, one who always recites or hears this rule, set forth in order by the great sage Angiras, has no sin.

verses.text:
विमुच्यते चापि स सर्वसंकरै-
र्न चास्य दोषैरभिभूयते मनः ।
वियोनिजानां च विजानते रुतं
ध्रुवां च कीर्तिं लभते नरोत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: He is freed from all entanglements, his mind is not overcome by faults, he understands the cries of creatures born from the womb of lower beings, and the best of men gains lasting fame.
